create_normal_distribution: create a Normal distribution with a given loc mean and scale standard deviation
sample_from_normal: sample random values from a Normal distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Normal distribution
calculate_kl_divergence: calculate the KL divergence between two Normal distributions using the registered TFP function
compute_entropy: compute the Shannon entropy in nats for a Normal distribution
